title: Tables that change
subtitle: A shared ledger, and three plans side by side

scenes.title: Everyone keeps the same list
scenes.narration: Instead of a bank, everyone keeps one shared list of who paid whom.

steps.say: Alice pays Charlie fifty, so he starts with fifty.
Then Charlie pays Bob twenty, which everyone writes down.
Now Charlie tries to pay David forty, but he only has thirty.
So everyone marks that payment as rejected.

scenes.title: Picking a plan for a small team
scenes.narration: Three plans, compared on what a small team cares about.

steps.say: The team has eight people, so look at seats first.
The free plan only has three seats, so it is out.
The team plan fits eight people for forty dollars a month.
